proposals.evidence: Turner lists Nepali dāuro firewood as the extended reflex of dāva. Bote dāurā and Dotyali dourā match this Nepali-area fuel term; this is distinct from retained-r dāru wood.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Kumauni/Nepali silauṭo and Bihari/Hindi silauṭ, siloṭ stone for grinding spices, from śilāpaṭṭa. These Terai and Nepal survey grinding slabs preserve both historical components, including the reduced silaṭ variants; they are not assigned to simple śilā.
